versions.subject: new rule: susp net use combo
versions.detection:
image:
    Image|contains: '\cmd.exe'
selection_base:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' net use http'
        - '& start /b '
        - '\DavWWWRoot\'
selection_ext:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '.exe '
        - '.dll '
        - '.bat '
        - '.vbs '
        - '.ps1 '
condition: image and all of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*\\cmd.exe*" CommandLine="* net use http*" CommandLine="*& start /b *" CommandLine="*\\DavWWWRoot\\*" CommandLine IN ("*.exe *", "*.dll *", "*.bat *", "*.vbs *", "*.ps1 *")
